Subject: URGENT!! THIRD REQUEST - RAMP STILL NOT SHOVELED

I am a disabled veteran in a wheelchair in the 2400 block of S. 12th St. I filled out your form Friday morning AND left a voicemail. It is now Saturday and my ramp and front walk still have every inch of Thursday's snow on them. I have food and I am fine inside, that is NOT the point. The city gives 24 hours before they write tickets. I need a call back TODAY at 414-555-0145 or my next email goes to the alderman's office.

Subject: Shoveling, and maybe groceries after

Good afternoon. I am 80 with a bad heart and my doctor told me no shoveling. I have the corner lot on N Palmer St at Hadley in Harambee, so it is a long stretch of sidewalk plus the front steps. The city wrote me up once before. Could your volunteers clear it this weekend? That is the main thing. Second, I usually take the bus to the store and I can't get out until it's cleared. I have enough food to last through Tuesday, but if some groceries could come by next week I would be grateful. Thank you, Harold, 414-555-0175

Her aunt, who is her emergency contact, is picking her up at 6 and wants to keep her for now, but asked for help making a safety plan and knowing what to do if anyone comes to the door. Please call the aunt at 414-555-0156.

Subject: Dying to get back to work

Hello, I saw your Bridge To Employment table mentioned on the Thursday live. I've been laid off since March and this job hunt is killing me. I've fired off forty-some applications and heard nothing. Honestly I'd kill for a steady second-shift warehouse spot. I have forklift experience and a clean driving record, and I'm in Sherman Park near Sherman and Center so I can bus anywhere on the 30. How do I sign up? Is it a class or do I just come in? Thanks.

Dismissal is at 3:25. His grandmother, Loretta, lives in Havenwoods and will keep him, but she has no car. Can your team help with a safety plan and a ride to her before dismissal? Reach me at 414-555-0162.

Subject: Could your team map winter clothing giveaways near Clarke Square?

Hello,
I keep the help sheet for our block club. We started it after the fire on our block two winters ago. Everyone got out fine and the building was rebuilt long ago, but the sheet is badly out of date. Could your research volunteers put together a list or simple map of places within walking distance of Clarke Square Park that give out coats, boots and kids' snow pants, with hours and whether they ask for ID? We would print it for our December meeting. No rush this week.
Thank you

Thanks, Imani

It's loud and my wife and I have both had a headache and felt sleepy all day, but we're warm. Could we get a food box today or tomorrow? We're near 38th and Garfield and will be home. Thank you kindly.
